name: isa-transfer-out-confirmation
subject: Please confirm your ISA transfer request
previewText: We have received a request to transfer money out of your Abundance IF ISA

fields.heading: Please confirm your ISA transfer request
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

We have received a request to transfer money from your Abundance IF ISA to another ISA provider.

Please log in to your Abundance account to review and confirm the transfer request. Once you have confirmed the transfer, we will send the money to your ISA provider.
